name: Halley
description: Comets streaming across the sky in loose shoals, each with a bright head, a broad curved dust tail and a thin straight ion tail.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: rotate(@rn(-200, 560)deg) scale(@r(0.8, 1.15)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -40%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--dust); clip-path: @var(--dust); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 12.2%, #000 58.9%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ion); clip-path: @var(--ion); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 13.9%, #000 56.7%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
